rows.grounds: compound: pitṛ-deva-pathau (dual, paths of fathers and gods) + asya (gen. sg.) + udak-dakṣiṇa-gau (dual, going north and south); verse 109, direction/sun-orientation context in deśādhvan
compound: sva-jāta-pare (nom./acc. dual fem. or loc. sg.), 'beyond those born of itself/own-born'; verse 109
compound: bhānoḥ (gen. sg., of the sun) + uttara-dakṣiṇa-ayana-dvayam (pair of north and south courses) + etat + eva; verse 109, sun-based orientation
kathayanti, 3rd pl. present indicative of kath-, 'they say/declare'; verse 109
